statement.notes: The schema requested only the 'depreciation_and_amortization' field. This value is directly provided as a single line item in the 'Adjustments to reconcile net income...' section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows for each year. No combination of elements is required. The supplementary tables contain related information (e.g., operating lease details) but do not provide a further breakdown of the consolidated depreciation and amortization figure itself.
